beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set our best plates out. A visitor wearing gold will bring us a fortune tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the plumber with brass fittings. I'll get his payment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Working gold. Leave the money; he'll be bringing ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His bill's enormous. We owe him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fortune changing hands. Precisely as foretold. Make the cheque payable to him; the prophecy concerns the amount, not the direction.

reason: Original A5 correctly uses the large bill to reverse the fortune, but adds an unsupported lifetime claim about never paying plumbers again. End on the specific amount-versus-direction revision caused by B4.
comparison: The plumber alternative redefines the beneficiary while paying; the moon alternative keeps observers waiting by redefining the time reference.
scope: Local writer revision only; no technical retries or fresh-review correction counters changed.
